item.title: Sakura no Sora to, Kimi no Koto -Sweet Petals For My Dear-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hiyoko Soft
  • 発売日: 2011-05-20
  • スコア: 6.609999999999999/10 (22 人評価)
  • 日本語名: サクラの空と、君のコト -Sweet Petals For My Dear-
  • 英語名: Sakura no Sora to, Kimi no Koto -Sweet Petals For My Dear-

あらすじ

It has been said that wishes will come true when the sky is full of cherry blossom petals. However, the number of sakura trees have dwindled due to recent re-development and one can no longer see such a sight. Ryou is the son of a famous artist and much was expected of him, but he decides to live a life of a commoner with few friends. One spring day, his childhood friend Kanata suddenly fainted and was hospitalized. Since that day, his days began to gradually change.

item.title: Tsukisome no Kasa -the end of scarlet luna-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hiyoko Soft
  • 発売日: 2010-01-29
  • スコア: 6.7/10 (21 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 月染の枷鎖-the end of scarlet luna-
  • 英語名: Tsukisome no Kasa -the end of scarlet luna-

あらすじ

The protagonist, Kagami Renka, moved to the remote country town of Hasumi-mura due to his stepfather’s new job. Renka intends to find information about his real parents after hearing that Hasumi-mura was his mother’s hometown. Renka’s mother died when he was young, and he never knew who his true father was.

item.title: Kurui ~Ryoujoku Kyoushitsu~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hiyoko Soft
  • 発売日: 2001-02-23
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 狂い ～凌辱教室～
  • 英語名: Kurui Ryoujoku Kyoushitsu

あらすじ

Our hero, Yosuke has become an expressionless being caused by the loss of his girlfriend from childhood, Yuki Hinata, who committed suicide. Yosuke enrolls in the university he and Yuki had planned on enrolling in together. Unfortunately, Yosuke’s wounded heart never recovers; his condition worsens to the point of him becoming a total recluse. He begins having counseling sessions with a young assistant professor named Kasumi. Even with these sessions, Yosuke does not recover. Yosuke and Kasumi gradually become intimate; without realizing it, they become bound in a physical relationship. For Yosuke, this relationship is nothing more than an instrument to satisfy his lustful desires. Losing himself in these day-to-day carnal pleasures, Yosuke has become enchanted with a reoccurring nightmare…

  • 日本語名: リフレイン ～もう一度、さよならを言おう～
  • 英語名: Refrain Mou Ichido, Sayonara o Iou

别名

  • リフレイン ～もう1度、さよならを言おう～

あらすじ

Main character can not understand why Rihoko has distanced from him. When an opportunity presents to be with Hatsune, he jumps at it, but relations stay at more than friends, less than lovers level. One day Rihoko visits protagonist for some minor reason, and feelings awaken anew. There is also a good friend Riko who he likes. Main character wants to be with all three girls… what a clumsy feeling.
